correctness.rationale: Convolution gives p_n=e^{−ε}ε^{n−1}(ε²+n(1−ε))/n!, mean 1, variance 2ε−ε², and (n!p_n)^2−(n−1)!p_{n−1}(n+1)!p_{n+1}=e^{−2ε}ε^{2n−2}(1−ε)^2>0. Detailed balance telescopes to sharp indicator envelope F_m(1−F_m)/(w p_m). Strict ratio monotonicity and r2<ε,r3<=ε/2 imply all sites j>=2 have envelope <=2/(3w); j=1 has (1−εe^{−ε})/w>2/(3w), so first site is unique maximizer. Hence Γ/(σ/w)~(2ε)^−1/2→∞. Exact algebra proves infinite support; inspected checker is only diagnostic.
